posts.preview: * If you are fired, intimidated or discriminated against because you joined or participated in a trade union, this may constitute an unfair labour practice. Report it to your union or a Labour Inspector.
* Workers in the same company should organise and join their union to strengthen collective bargaining on issues such as wage increases, disciplinary hearings and grievances.
* Elect and fully support your workplace representatives to represent workers effectively.
* Trade unions must provide proper training and capacity-building for shop stewards so that they can effectively represent members.
